Package io.github.imetaxas.realitycheck.spring

Class SpringContextCheck

java.lang.Object
io.github.imetaxas.realitycheck.AbstractCheck<SpringContextCheck,org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext>
io.github.imetaxas.realitycheck.spring.SpringContextCheck
All Implemented Interfaces:
Check<SpringContextCheck,org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext>
public final class SpringContextCheck extends AbstractCheck<SpringContextCheck,org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext>
Fluent assertions for a Spring ApplicationContext, covering the AssertJ ApplicationContextAssert methods used in typical auto-configuration tests. 

 import static io.github.imetaxas.realitycheck.spring.SpringReality.assertThatContext;

 assertThatContext(context).hasSingleBean(MyService.class);
 assertThatContext(context).doesNotHaveBean(LegacyService.class);
 assertThatContext(context).bean(MyService.class).isInstanceOf(MyServiceImpl.class);
 assertThatContext(context).hasBean("myService").doesNotHaveBean("legacyService");
 assertThatContext(context).hasNotFailed();

hasFailed(), hasNotFailed(), and failure() prefer getStartupFailure() when the context exposes that method (Spring Boot ApplicationContextRunner). Otherwise a ConfigurableApplicationContext is treated as failed when ConfigurableApplicationContext.isActive() is false.

      public <T> ObjectCheck<T> bean(Class<T> type)
      Continues assertions on a bean of type. If several beans exist, BeanFactory.getBean(Class) is used so a unique @Primary bean is accepted.
      Parameters:
      type - the bean type to look up; must not be null
      Returns:
      an ObjectCheck over the bean, or over null after a failure
